page.title: Marbella Sunset Photoshoot Yacht Session: 2040 Experience

data.meta_description: Book a sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella 2040 session aboard our luxury fleet. Capture golden-hour portraits from Puerto Banús with a pro photographer included.
data.summary: A 2040 sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella experience that combines a luxury charter with a professional photographer for golden-hour portraits on the Mediterranean.
key_facts: Sunset sessions run from 18:30 to 20:30 (May-Oct) or 17:00 to 19:00 (Nov-Apr)

faq.q: What boats are available for the sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella 2040 session?
faq.a: We offer five boats for this experience: the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax), Speedboat (7m, 6 pax), Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax), Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax), and Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax). Each departs from Puerto Banús or Marbella Marina. The smaller boats are ideal for intimate couples' shoots, while the larger yachts suit groups or family portraits.

faq.q: What is included in the sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella 2040 package?
faq.a: Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). A professional photographer is also included for the full 2-hour session. You'll receive a digital gallery of edited, high-resolution images within 5 working days.

faq.q: How long is the sunset photoshoot session?
faq.a: The standard session lasts 2 hours, timed to capture the golden hour. From May to October, we typically depart at 18:30 and return by 20:30. From November to April, the timing shifts to 17:00–19:00. We can adjust the departure time slightly based on your preference, as long as it aligns with the sunset.

faq.q: Can I bring my own photographer instead of using yours?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring your own photographer at no extra cost. However, the standard package includes a professional photographer who knows the best angles and lighting conditions on the water. If you prefer a specific style or have a portfolio you like, just let us know in advance.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on my scheduled day?
faq.a: If bad weather (rain, high winds, or rough seas) forces a cancellation, we will reschedule your session at no additional charge. You can also choose a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will contact you at least 24 hours before departure if conditions look unfavourable.

faq.q: Do I need to bring anything for the photoshoot?
faq.a: Bring your own outfits, props, and any personal items you want in the photos. The boat is fully equipped with drinks and snacks. We recommend light, breathable clothing for comfort, and avoid white if you want to stand out against the sky. Sunscreen and sunglasses are also advisable.

faq.q: Can I book the sunset photoshoot for a proposal or special occasion?
faq.a: Absolutely. Many clients book this session for engagements, anniversaries, or birthday surprises. We can coordinate with you beforehand to arrange a proposal moment (e.g., a hidden ring, a toast at the right time). Just let us know when you book, and we'll tailor the timing and photographer's cues.

faq.q: How do I book the sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella 2040 session?
faq.a: Book directly via our website or contact us on WhatsApp. For boats in Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive. For the Dubhe, Speedboat, and Lagoon 380, pricing is on request. We require a 50% deposit to secure your date, with the balance due 7 days before departure.

data.body_html:
Capture the Mediterranean at its most magical hour with a sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella 2040 session. This 2-hour private charter from Puerto Banús pairs a luxury boat with a professional photographer, so you get stunning golden-hour portraits without any of the logistics. Whether it's a couples' shoot, a family album update, or content for your social feed, the combination of a sleek yacht, open sea, and the Costa del Sol sunset creates a backdrop that's hard to beat.

Why a 2040 sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella session works

The golden hour on the Mediterranean lasts roughly 60–90 minutes, and our session is timed to make the most of it. Departing from Puerto Banús, you'll cruise along the coast toward Cabopino or the Marbella Marina, depending on wind and light conditions. The photographer will guide you through poses, use natural light, and incorporate the yacht's lines and the distant La Concha mountain into the frame. All images are edited and delivered digitally within five working days.

Which boats are available for the photoshoot

We offer five boats for this experience, each departing from Puerto Banús. The Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are ideal for intimate couples' sessions. For larger groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) provide more deck space and a flybridge for varied angles. The Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) is a catamaran with a stable platform and a trampoline net—great for candid shots. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

What's included in the sunset photoshoot package

  • 2-hour private charter with licensed skipper
  • Professional photographer for the full session
  • Edited digital gallery (high-resolution, 20+ images)
  • Fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks
  • Insurance and Spanish IVA (21%)

For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive. For the Dubhe, Speedboat, and Lagoon 380, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

Best spots for sunset photos on the Marbella coast

Our skippers know the prime anchorages for sunset light. Common locations include Cala del Faro, just east of Puerto Banús, where the cliffs catch the last rays; Cala Cortés, a quieter cove near Cabopino; and the waters off the Golden Mile, where the sky reflects off the luxury villas. The photographer will choose the best spot based on wind and cloud cover to maximise the golden-hour glow.

How to prepare for your photoshoot session

Wear what makes you feel confident—flowy dresses, linen shirts, or swimwear all work well. Avoid large logos or busy patterns that distract from the background. Bring a change of clothes if you want two looks. The boat has a small cabin where you can change. Sunscreen is essential, even at sunset, as the sea reflects UV rays. Arrive 15 minutes early at Puerto Banús to meet the skipper and photographer.

Book your sunset photoshoot yacht Marbella 2040 session

Ready to book? Contact us via WhatsApp or use the booking form on our site. For Tier A boats, the price is €749 for 2 hours. For other boats, we'll provide a quote within 24 hours. A 50% deposit secures your date. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance, especially from June to September, when sunset slots fill quickly. See all our boat rental Marbella options for more ideas.
